The purpose of this project is twofold:

1)  to collate all available scRNA-seq and snRNA-seq data that exists for medulloblastoma mediated by the Sonic Hedgehog cell signaling pathway for characterization of cell types and marker gene expression.

2)  to determine how metacell representation of single cell data can be preserved and optimized to categorize cell types.

# Part 1

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, cache = FALSE}

# Folder to save images in Part 1
```

### Step 1: Import data

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache=TRUE, cache.lazy=FALSE}

FOLDER_Gold  <- "/home/gak190001/downloads/GSE214469_nuclei/"
PROJECT_Gold <- "GSE214469"
SPECIES_Gold <- "human"
ASSAY_Gold   <- "nuclei"

get_sample_name_Gold <- function(filename) {
  base  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filename))
  parts <- strsplit(base, "_")[[1]]
  return(tail(parts, 1))
}

h5_files_Gold <- c(
  "/home/gak190001/downloads/GSE214469_nuclei/GSM6607000_filtered_feature_bc_matrix_mb0595.h5",
  "/home/gak190001/downloads/GSE214469_nuclei/GSM6607001_filtered_feature_bc_matrix_mb0601.h5",
  "/home/gak190001/downloads/GSE214469_nuclei/GSM6607002_filtered_feature_bc_matrix_mb2112.h5",
  "/home/gak190001/downloads/GSE214469_nuclei/GSM6607003_filtered_feature_bc_matrix_mb3400.h5",
  "/home/gak190001/downloads/GSE214469_nuclei/GSM6607004_filtered_feature_bc_matrix_mb3612.h5",
  "/home/gak190001/downloads/GSE214469_nuclei/GSM6607005_filtered_feature_bc_matrix_mb3201.h5",
  "/home/gak190001/downloads/GSE214469_nuclei/GSM6607006_filtered_feature_bc_matrix_mb4113.h5"
)

qc_sample_Gold <- function(h5_path) {
  samp <- get_sample_name_Gold(h5_path)
  cat("Reading:", samp, "\n")
  counts <- Read10X_h5(h5_path, use.names = TRUE, unique.features = TRUE)
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts,
                             assay        = "RNA",
                             min.cells    = 5,
                             min.features = 300,
                             project      = PROJECT_Gold)
  obj <- AddMetaData(obj, samp,                                  col.name = "sample_Gold")
  obj <- AddMetaData(obj, ASSAY_Gold,                            col.name = "assay")
  obj <- AddMetaData(obj, SPECIES_Gold,                          col.name = "species")
  obj <- AddMetaData(obj, paste0(PROJECT_Gold, "-", ASSAY_Gold), col.name = "project")
  obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^MT-")
  scrub_path <- paste0("/home/gak190001/downloads/scrublet_files/", samp, ".csv")
  scrub      <- read.csv(scrub_path, row.names = 1)
  obj        <- AddMetaData(obj, scrub)
  cq5  <- quantile(obj@meta.data$nCount_RNA,   0.05)
  cq95 <- quantile(obj@meta.data$nCount_RNA,   0.95)
  fq5  <- quantile(obj@meta.data$nFeature_RNA, 0.05)
  fq95 <- quantile(obj@meta.data$nFeature_RNA, 0.95)
  obj <- subset(obj,
                subset = nCount_RNA   >= cq5  &
                         nCount_RNA   <= cq95 &
                         nFeature_RNA >= fq5  &
                         nFeature_RNA <= fq95 &
                         percent.mt   <  5    &
                         Call90       == "Good")
  cat("  Cells after QC:", ncol(obj), "\n")
  return(obj)
}

Gold_list   <- lapply(h5_files_Gold, qc_sample_Gold)
names(Gold_list) <- sapply(h5_files_Gold, get_sample_name_Gold)

Gold_merged <- merge(Gold_list[[1]],
                     y            = Gold_list[-1],
                     add.cell.ids = names(Gold_list),
                     project      = PROJECT_Gold)

cat("Total cells after per-sample QC and merge:", ncol(Gold_merged), "\n")
```

### Step 2: Quality Control

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = TRUE}

# Feature scatter
FS_plot1_Gold <- FeatureScatter(Gold_merged, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt",   raster = FALSE)
FS_plot2_Gold <- FeatureScatter(Gold_merged, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA", raster = FALSE)

combinedScatter<- FS_plot1_Gold + FS_plot2_Gold
combinedScatter

# Save Image
ggsave(file.path(img_dir1_Gold, "combinedScatter_Gold.png"), plot = combinedScatter, width = 20, height = 8, bg = "white")
```

### Step 3: Data Normalization

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = TRUE}

Gold_merged <- NormalizeData(Gold_merged,
                              normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                              scale.factor         = 10000)
cat("Normalization complete\n")
```

### Step 4: Feature Selection and Heterogeneity Analysis

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = TRUE}

Gold_merged <- FindVariableFeatures(Gold_merged,
                                     selection.method = "vst",
                                     nfeatures        = 2500)

top10_Gold <- head(VariableFeatures(Gold_merged), 10)
cat("Top 10 variable features:", paste(top10_Gold, collapse = ", "), "\n")

VF_plot1_Gold <- VariableFeaturePlot(Gold_merged)
VF_plot2_Gold <- LabelPoints(plot   = VF_plot1_Gold,
                              points = top10_Gold,
                              repel  = TRUE)
combinedVariableFeatures_All <- VF_plot1_Gold + VF_plot2_Gold
combinedVariableFeatures_All

# Save Image
ggsave(file.path(img_dir1_Gold, "combinedVariableFeatures_Gold.png"), plot = combinedVariableFeatures_All, width = 12, height = 9, bg = "white")
```

### Step 5: Data Scaling

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = TRUE}

Gold_merged <- ScaleData(Gold_merged,
                          features        = VariableFeatures(Gold_merged),
                          vars.to.regress = "nCount_RNA",
                          verbose         = TRUE)
cat("Scaling complete\n")
```

### Step 6: PCA

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = TRUE}

Gold_merged <- RunPCA(Gold_merged,
                      features = VariableFeatures(Gold_merged),
                      verbose  = FALSE)

cat("PCA complete\n")

# --- Scree (Elbow) Plot ---
PC_ElbowPlot_Gold <- ElbowPlot(Gold_merged, ndims = 50)

ggsave(
  file.path(img_dir1_Gold, "PC_ElbowPlot_Gold.png"),
  plot  = PC_ElbowPlot_Gold,
  width = 12,
  height = 9,
  bg    = "white"
)

# --- Heatmap (DimHeatmap) ---
PCs_Heatmap_Gold_file <- file.path(img_dir1_Gold, "PCs_Heatmap_Riemondy.png")

png(
  filename = PCs_Heatmap_Gold_file,
  width    = 2000,
  height   = 5000,
  res      = 150,
  bg       = "white"
)

DimHeatmap(
  Gold_merged,
  dims     = 1:15,
  cells    = 500,
  balanced = TRUE
)

dev.off()

# Top genes per PC
print(Gold_merged[["pca"]], dims = 1:10, nfeatures = 5)
```

Step 7

```{r}

Gold_merged <- RunHarmony(Gold_merged, group.by.vars = "sample_Gold")
cat("Harmony complete\n")

# Authors explicitly use dims 1:50, resolution 0.25
Gold_merged <- RunUMAP(Gold_merged,       reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:50)
Gold_merged <- FindNeighbors(Gold_merged, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:50)
Gold_merged <- FindClusters(Gold_merged,  resolution = 0.25)

cat("Clusters found:", length(unique(Idents(Gold_merged))), "\n")
print(table(Idents(Gold_merged)))

# ── Cell type annotation ─────────────────────────────────────
annot_list_Gold <- list("8"  = "Fibroblast",
                         "9"  = "Macrophage",
                         "11" = "Astrocyte",
                         "12" = "Oligodendrocyte",
                         "14" = "Microglia",
                         "6"  = "Immune-Other")

Gold_idents <- as.character(Idents(Gold_merged))
Gold_annots <- as.character(sapply(Gold_idents, function(x) {
  if (x %in% names(annot_list_Gold)) annot_list_Gold[[x]] else "Tumor"
}))
Gold_merged <- AddMetaData(Gold_merged, Gold_annots, col.name = "CellType")

# ── Publication colors ───────────────────────────────────────
celltype_colors_Gold <- c("Astrocyte"       = "#009265",
                           "Tumor"           = "#4EA8DA",
                           "Fibroblast"      = "#DA692F",
                           "Immune-Other"    = "#6D75B6",
                           "Macrophage"      = "#EC2393",
                           "Microglia"       = "#4CAD50",
                           "Oligodendrocyte" = "#E9A52A")

# ── UMAP by cluster ──────────────────────────────────────────
UMAP_cluster_Gold <- DimPlot(Gold_merged,
                              reduction = "umap",
                              label     = TRUE,
                              pt.size   = 0.5) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  ggtitle("Clusters (res = 0.25, dims = 1:50)")
UMAP_cluster_Gold

# ── UMAP by cell type with publication colors ─────────────────
UMAP_celltype_Gold <- DimPlot(Gold_merged,
                               reduction = "umap",
                               group.by  = "CellType",
                               cols      = celltype_colors_Gold,
                               label     = TRUE,
                               pt.size   = 0.5) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  ggtitle("Cell Type")
UMAP_celltype_Gold
```

Sanity check

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = TRUE}

Gold_merged <- JoinLayers(Gold_merged, assay = "RNA")
Idents(Gold_merged) <- "CellType"

markers_Gold <- FindAllMarkers(
  Gold_merged,
  only.pos        = TRUE,
  min.pct         = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)

top_markers_Gold <- markers_Gold %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 3) 
top_genes_Gold <- unique(top_markers_Gold$gene)
top_markers_Gold

genes_by_celltype_Gold <- split(
  top_markers_Gold$gene,
  top_markers_Gold$cluster
)

genes_by_celltype_Gold
```
